placements.text: Every price update came through the same corporate feed. The shops did not choose it individually.
The message content is encrypted. The meeting confirmation is not. Same names, same time, one private room.
Barkington has a private dinner tonight.
The same network telling everyone to panic-buy salmon.
Steak and Bone. Their public booking map shows a service corridor behind the dining room.
So we walk in and ask nicely?
We watch. We record. We leave. Nobody starts a fight over a suspicion.
A photograph of two dogs having dinner is not going to prove much.
Correct. Which is why we need to hear what they say.
The microphone needs line of sight. I can hide it in the service hatch.
Then let's see what's on the menu.

status: dialogue review assembly, not final soundtrack
